senses.gloss: Ulkādhārin, n. of a Bodhisattva: Gv 〔442.25〕.
Ulkāmukhī, n. of a rākṣasī: Māy 〔243.24〕. Cf. Skt. Ulkāmukhaḥ, a kind of ghost (preta); n. of a rakṣas (BR); and see prec. (2), Tib. (Das).

ulkin (Skt. ulkā plus -in), perhaps a portent containing a meteor, or some personified power characterized by, carrying, wielding a meteor(?); the passages are obscure and in part clearly corrupt; in verses: Mmk 〔198.15〕 ˚nāṃ (gen. pl.?), 25 ˚naḥ (gen. sg., see prapata); 〔200.15〕 ulkino (nom. pl.) bahudhākārā dṛśyante vividhāśrayā; 〔204.5〕 ˚nāṃ (gen. pl.); 〔223.2〕 nirghāta ulkinām (gen. pl.).
